steps.name: time-schema
steps.summary: Added nullable timestamptz time-block fields (planned_start/end, actual_start/end) to nodes; migration 0001 generated and applied to Supabase, RLS unchanged; optimisticNode in hooks/nodes.ts updated to match FlatNode.

steps.name: calendar-grid
steps.summary: Calendar day grid (07:00→02:00) renders timed task blocks (top=start, height=duration) and creates a 1h task on empty-slot click via optimistic useAddNode; time→pixel math is pure in core/time/calendar.ts (+tests); AddNodeInput/POST route extended with plannedStart/End; globals.css retuned minimal (off-white, hairline borders, Geist body font); home page now shows CalendarGrid.

steps.name: drag-resize
steps.summary: Calendar blocks move (body drag) and resize (bottom-edge drag) via dnd-kit; pixel deltas snap to 15-min steps and commit through optimistic useUpdateNode (plannedStart/End on move, plannedEnd on resize) with live preview reusing the same pure core/time math (moveBlock/resizeBlockEnd/snapMinutes, +tests); resizeBlockEnd clamps to MIN_BLOCK_MINUTES so a block never inverts; PATCH /api/nodes/[id] now accepts plannedStart/End ISO strings so drags persist.
